disambiguation: Not a proprietary mindmap tool; it uses standard Markdown list items for structure.
extras: Supports mobile and Apple Pencil input; uses Cytoscape.js, Dagre, Simple Whiteboard, and perfect-freehand libraries.
intentEvidence: Excerpt-Outline-Mindmap-Editor is an Obsidian plugin for working with Markdown outlines as visual mindmaps.
motivation: I do this primarily to bridge certain gaps in my own workflow.
problem: Users need a way to visualize and navigate complex, hierarchical research notes and literature excerpts spatially.

relations.evidence: If the Excalidraw plugin is installed and enabled, the node context menu additionally offers Add Excalidraw drawing as child and Add Excalidraw drawing as sibling.

summary: A visual drag-and-drop mindmap editor that allows users to restructure Markdown outlines spatially while maintaining compatibility with standard text editors.
